description: The plot shows training loss as a function of iteration for six methods/configurations, with multiple colored lines and translucent bands around each line indicating variability around the main trace. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with regularly spaced tick marks every 20,000 iterations. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at 0.1 intervals. The “Vanilla” curve is drawn in purple with a solid line and no markers; it starts near the top of the axis (around 3.4 at iteration 0), drops steeply to roughly the mid–2.6 to 2.7 range within the first ~10,000 iterations, and then decreases gradually to about 2.47 by 140,000. The “StrmLLM (n=64)” curve is light blue, solid, with no markers; it begins around 3.4, falls quickly to roughly ~2.8 by ~10,000 iterations, and then declines more slowly, ending near about 2.61 at 140,000. The “SepLLM (n=64)” curve is orange, solid, with no markers; it starts around 3.4, drops to about ~2.7 by ~10,000, and then steadily decreases to roughly ~2.52 at 140,000. The “SepLLM (n=64, H)” curve is green, solid, with no markers; it follows a similar sharp early decrease from around 3.4 to the high–2.6/low–2.7 range by ~10,000 and then gradually declines, ending near about ~2.51 at 140,000. The “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” curve is red, solid, with no markers; it also drops from around 3.4 to the mid–2.6 range early and then trends downward to approximately ~2.49–2.50 by 140,000. The “SepLLM (n=128)” curve is a darker blue, solid, with no markers; it begins around 3.4, decreases rapidly to roughly ~2.7 by ~10,000, and then slowly declines toward about ~2.50–2.51 at 140,000.
